paper_title: CodeRAG-Bench Can Retrieval Augment Code Generation
caption: Performance with different chunking sizes.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of tokens and a performance metric for four different data sources. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Tokens", has a linear scale, spans from 200 to 800, and tick labels are placed at intervals of 200.  The y-axis is not explicitly labeled, has a linear scale, spans from 10 to 40, and tick labels are placed at intervals of 10.  The blue line, representing "Tutorials", begins at approximately 22 at 200 tokens, rises to approximately 28 at 600 tokens, and then decreases slightly to approximately 26 at 800 tokens. The red line, representing "Library Documentation", starts at approximately 26 at 200 tokens, rises to approximately 31 at 600 tokens, and then increases to approximately 33 at 800 tokens. The yellow line, representing "StackOverflow posts", begins at approximately 32 at 200 tokens and steadily declines to approximately 17 at 800 tokens. Finally, the green line, representing "Github files", starts at approximately 30 at 200 tokens, decreases to approximately 28 at 600 tokens, and then increases to approximately 32 at 800 tokens.
